title: Block Out Level 13 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 13 is a pressure board with a crowded right wall and top counters. Soften the right lane first, keep the upper blue band parked as a brace, and collapse the cyan slabs only after the red lane opens.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

landmarks: Block Out Level 13 is a pressure board with a crowded right wall and top counters.
Soften the right lane first, keep the upper blue band parked as a brace, and collapse the cyan slabs only after the red lane opens.
The board mixes Cyan, Yellow, Blue and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The right red lane matters before the top blue band.
Cyan slabs should move after the counters, not before them.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the right-edge pieces into the red wall so the tiny `1` side counter disappears first.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Keep shrinking the top `3` and `4` counters while the cyan `10` slab stays parked in the middle.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the yellow belts to bridge across the center only after the right lane is no longer clogged.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Drop the cyan `8` and `6` slabs in sequence so the middle row stops pinning the blue band.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Release the upper blue band once the top counters are nearly exhausted.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish by clearing the last yellow belts and then the final cyan `5` slab.

failurePoints: Moving the top blue band before the right red lane has opened.
Trying to force the cyan `10` slab down while the top counters are still high.
